name: filter-panel
title: Filter Panel
description: Every filter of a schema in one form, applied together: a SidePanel beside the results on wide screens, a bottom Drawer sheet on narrow ones; Apply and Reset.
docs: `<FilterPanel open onOpenChange />` inside a `FilterScope` (or with `schema` and `controller`), toggled by `<FilterPanelTrigger open onOpenChange count />`, which shows how many filters apply (`countActiveFilters`). `ServerDataTable filterUi="panel"` puts both in place. Each field is a `FilterField` editing a draft; Apply (a submit button, so Enter works) sends it, Reset clears the fields the panel shows and applies at once. It is a `SidePanel` with `narrow="sheet"`: at 760px and below a modal bottom sheet that Apply closes; wider, non-modal beside the results, staying open, closing on Escape and returning focus to `returnFocus`. The draft starts again whenever the applied filters change elsewhere, like a chip or the URL. `labels` names the title, Apply, Reset and Close, in English by default.
